title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
description:
Digital Marketing & Content Designer

Salary: £32,000 - £35,000 per annum
Hours: 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm
Location: Office-Based

The Role

We are recruiting on behalf of a successful and growing business seeking a creative and driven Digital Marketing & Content Designer to support its ongoing growth strategy.

This varied role combines digital marketing, content creation, copywriting, graphic design, and website management. Working closely with the Marketing Manager, you will create engaging campaigns, compelling content, and high-quality marketing materials while helping to strengthen the company's digital presence across websites, email marketing, social media, and customer engagement platforms.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
- Manage and grow social media platforms.
- Support SEO initiatives and website optimisation.
- Create, schedule, and monitor email marketing campaigns.
- Analyse campaign performance and provide recommendations.
- Produce engaging website content, blogs, articles, case studies, and social media content.
- Develop compelling product and solution messaging.
- Design digital marketing assets including social graphics, website banners, email graphics, infographics, and digital adverts.
- Create and maintain branded marketing collateral and presentation materials.
- Manage website content updates, landing pages, and campaign pages.
- Coordinate digital content across online platforms.
- Maintain marketing calendars, content libraries, and campaign schedules.
- Support events, exhibitions, product launches, and wider business initiatives.

About You

Essential Skills & Experience
- Experience in a digital marketing role.
- Strong SEO knowledge.
- Excellent copywriting and content creation skills.
- Graphic design experience.
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
- Experience using Mac OS.
- Social media management experience.
- Knowledge of email marketing platforms.
- Experience using Google Analytics or similar reporting tools.
- Experience managing website CMS platforms.
- Familiarity with marketing automation systems.
- Strong organisational and project management skills.
- Excellent communication and numeracy skills.

Desirable
- Video editing and content creation experience.
- B2 B marketing experience.
- Photography or videography skills.
- Motion graphics experience, including Adobe After Effects.
- Experience supporting LMS platforms.

Personal Attributes
- Creative and commercially minded.
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Proactive and self-motivated.
- Able to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
- Customer-focused and data-driven.
- Adaptable and eager to learn.

Benefits
- 20 days holiday plus Bank Holidays.
- Additional 3 days off over Christmas/New Year.
- Free onsite parking.
- Complimentary tea and coffee.
- Company Sick Pay following successful probation.
- Pension scheme available after 3 months' service.
- Staff discount on company products.

If you're a creative marketing professional with a passion for digital campaigns, content creation, and design, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today with your CV and portfolio.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded Digital Marketing Manager to lead and optimise our digital marketing activity across the Sytner Group.

This is a key role within the Group Marketing team, responsible for overseeing digital performance, guiding investment across all brands and dealerships, and ensuring our digital channels deliver measurable business results.

The successful candidate will combine a deep understanding of digital marketing with strong commercial awareness, helping to maximise returns from our media spend while identifying new opportunities to drive enquiries, leads and sales.

Key Responsibilities:
- Oversee digital marketing strategy across the Sytner Group.
- Manage and optimise investment across Paid Search, Paid Social and other digital channels.
- Monitor, analyse and report on digital performance, ensuring spend is aligned to business objectives and delivers strong ROI.
- Work closely with our agency partners to develop, implement and continually refine digital strategies.
- Provide guidance and governance on digital budgets, ensuring effective allocation of spend across brands and campaigns.
- Leverage platforms such as Google Analytics, Meta Business Manager and other digital reporting tools to drive data-led decisions.
- Identify emerging trends, technologies and platform developments, translating them into opportunities for the business.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure digital activity supports wider marketing and commercial goals.
- Develop performance reporting and insights that inform strategic decision making across the Group.

About You

You will be an experienced digital marketing professional with a strong track record of managing performance-led digital campaigns and budgets.

You'll have:
- Significant experience in Paid Search and Paid Social marketing.
- Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics, Meta, Google Ads and digital attribution.
- A commercial mindset with the ability to balance brand objectives and business performance.
- Experience managing agency relationships and holding partners accountable for delivery and results.
- Excellent analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights.
- A proactive approach to staying ahead of industry developments, platform updates and emerging digital trends.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
- The ability to work effectively across multiple brands and priorities within a fast-paced environment.

Why Sytner?

Sytner Group are delighted to provide an industry-leading benefits package.

We are passionate about continuous improvement and building an environment where everyone feels valued, appreciated and able to reach their full potential.
- Enhanced Holiday Entitlement - 33 days inc. bank holidays
- Industry-leading Maternity, Paternity and Adoption Pay
- Career Development
- Recognition of Long Service every 5 years
- Discounted Car Schemes
- High Street Discounts
- Discounted Gym memberships
- Cycle to work scheme
- One day a year paid voluntary / community work

At Sytner, our values and the way we behave are important to us. We are committed to creating an equitable working environment where we value and respect every individual's unique contribution, supporting our colleagues to thrive and achieve their full potential.

As part of our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion, you have the right to ask for changes / adjustments to job interviews and the recruitment process. For more information around reasonable adjustments and the recruitment process please .

Unsure? Read on

We represent over 23 of the world's most prestige vehicle brands, across our 140 UK dealerships.

We pride ourselves on 'Developing Talent and 'Building Careers' and our colleagues recently scored Sytner Group an outstanding 89% on our colleague engagement survey.

title: Growth Marketing Executive
description:
An opportunity for a commercially minded B2 B marketer to own marketing and lead generation at a growing food ingredients business. This is a hands-on, results-driven role where HubSpot and AI tools sit at the centre of how you work, turning interest into qualified leads for the sales team.

Growth Marketing Executive

Location: Coalville
- £30,000 - £35,000 per annum + Excellent Benefits
- Full-time, Permanent
- Hours: 40 hours per week (30 minutes unpaid lunch)

Please note: you must be authorised to work in the UK.

About Us

The BakeRite Company is an experienced importer, stockist and distributor of healthy, natural and free-from ingredients for the specialist bakery and food and drink markets. We are a stable, family-owned business with open communication, accessible leadership and a collaborative team culture.

About the Role

Reporting to the Sales & Marketing Manager, you will drive BakeRite's marketing and lead generation, working closely with Sales, NPD and senior management. The aim is a strong, consistent BakeRite brand and a steady flow of the right leads, with marketing measured by the results it delivers. This role is office-based in Coalville.

Key responsibilities
- Plan and deliver marketing campaigns on time and within budget, and act as guardian of the BakeRite brand
- Build target account lists in HubSpot, set up lead scoring and routing, and qualify website enquiries before handing them to Sales
- Create landing pages, gated content and targeted email campaigns, and lead our move of email marketing into HubSpot
- Manage the website, SEO and LinkedIn, including a weekly post and a monthly market update
- Use Claude and other AI tools daily to build repeatable workflows that research markets and accounts, draft content and automate routine tasks
- Keep HubSpot data clean and report monthly on leads, conversion and campaign results
- Produce sales collateral, including the company presentation, product sheets and the annual brochure and catalogue, and organise trade shows, client visits and sample packs

About You

Skills and experience
- 2-3 years' B2 B marketing experience
- Hands-on HubSpot (or similar CRM and email platform) experience
- Practical use of generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot at work, with examples you can show us
- Website CMS, SEO and LinkedIn experience, with working knowledge of UK GDPR and PECR as they apply to marketing
- Excellent written English, with strong copywriting and proofreading skills
- Strong analytical skills and confidence with data, Excel and reporting
- Well organised, with experience planning events, visits or similar logistics

Desirable
- Food, ingredients, bakery, FMCG or B2 B manufacturing experience
- HubSpot Academy certifications
- Experience building AI-driven workflows (Claude projects and skills, Zapier, Make)
- Canva and/or Adobe skills, plus photography and video
- A marketing degree or CIM qualification
- Full UK driving licence

Benefits
- Competitive remuneration package, enhanced pension contributions and enhanced sick pay scheme
- 20 days holiday plus your birthday off, plus bank holidays (29 days per annum)
- Additional holiday entitlement for long service
- Access to company-funded private medical insurance for you and your family
- Free breakfast and lunch, with soft drinks, tea and coffee available all day
- Funded opportunities for ongoing training and professional development
- Modern Coalville office with free on-site parking and EV charging

How to Apply

If you have the skills and experience required for this Growth Marketing Executive position based in Coalville, click "apply" today and check your inbox for an email providing more information on how to tailor your application and provide a cover letter or any supporting documents.

No agencies please.

Other suitable skills and experience include: Growth Marketing Executive, Marketing Executive, B2 B Marketing Executive, Digital Marketing Executive, Lead Generation Executive, Content Marketing Executive, Marketing Officer or Marketing Coordinator.

title: Senior Marketing Executive
company: Macildowie Recruitment and Retention - Agency - Permanent
description:
Senior Marketing Executive
Barwell, office based
09:00 - 17:00, Monday to Friday

Are you a creative, hands-on marketer who loves variety, enjoys bringing products to life and isn't afraid to roll up your sleeves?

We're working with an established, product-led business in Leicester that's looking for a talented Senior Marketing Executive to join its team. This is a fantastic opportunity for a marketing generalist who enjoys getting involved in everything from campaign planning and graphic design to product marketing, website development and digital activity.

You'll be joining a business with a recognisable brand, a diverse product portfolio and an established team around you. They're looking for somebody who can bring fresh ideas, take ownership and help drive marketing activity forward.

The Role

No two days will look quite the same! You'll be responsible for delivering a broad range of marketing activity, combining creativity with commercial thinking.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Planning, coordinating and delivering marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
- Creating engaging marketing materials using Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop.
- Supporting product launches, promotions and wider product marketing initiatives.
- Developing and maintaining website content through Shopify, including SEO optimisation.
- Working alongside the ecommerce team to support product visibility across Shopify, Amazon, eBay and other online marketplaces.
- Producing creative assets, brochures, product literature and promotional materials.
- Monitoring campaign performance and using insights to improve future marketing activity.
- Supporting wider brand development and marketing projects across the business.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for somebody who has a strong foundation in marketing, enjoys being hands-on and can confidently manage a varied workload.

To be successful, you'll need:
- Proven experience in a broad marketing role, ideally within a product-led business.
- Strong graphic design skills using Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop.
- Experience developing and delivering marketing plans and campaigns.
- A good understanding of product marketing and how to communicate product benefits effectively.
- Hands-on experience with Shopify website development and SEO.
- An understanding of selling through ecommerce platforms, including Amazon, eBay and Shopify.
- Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and an analytical approach.

It Would Be Great If You Also Have:
- Experience working in a B2 B marketing environment.
- Previous people management or supervisory experience.
- Social media management experience.
- Experience delivering email marketing campaigns.

Interested?

If you're a creative marketing generalist who loves variety, has strong Adobe skills and enjoys seeing the commercial impact of your work, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.
